Title: General availability: Ingest up to 10 files and blobs with the new Azure Data Explorer intuitive UX

Body.Content:
You can now easily ingest blobs or files into Azure Data Explorer with the new ingestion intuitive wizard. This ingestion wizard also allows you to create a table automatically based on the source structure.

Select Data Management on the left pane menu, to reach all ingestion and creation capabilities that supported by ingestion wizard.

Select "Ingest from a blob", "Ingest from a file", or "Ingest data” which allows you to add references to up to 10 source files for easy ingestion without writing a line of code and with full control on the table schema.  This action is fully revertible, if needed.

Learn more about data ingestion capabilities.
